**1. Final Design Decisions**

- The old six-page Panchavati chart is reference-only, not the active design target.
- The active target is a compact-v4 evolution of `design/panchavati-compv3.html`, preserving all source data while improving density.
- The chart must remain a calm operational document, not a dashboard:
  - no cards around every section;
  - no shadows, pills, decorative icons, double borders or excessive whitespace;
  - thin rules, disciplined tables, horizontal bands and lanes.
- Persistent application header:
  - Maharashtra Police logo;
  - station identity;
  - grouped navigation;
  - language toggle;
  - richer date selector.
- English and Marathi labels must not be duplicated. UI language controls labels; source names, ranks and protected operational terms remain unchanged.
- Chart-specific controls belong below the persistent header:
  - lifecycle state;
  - edit;
  - finalize;
  - print.
- Printed header is one centered line:

  `नाशिक शहर पोलीस आयुक्तालय      दैनिक कर्तव्य वाटप      १० सप्टेंबर २०२६, गुरुवार`

- Page 1 keeps the SPI-approved hierarchy:
  - senior officer in one compact line;
  - dynamic writer/driver/RTPC/operator columns;
  - four subordinate officer areas in a compact horizontal grid;
  - paired day/night deployment below.
- Day and night use comparable groupings. They must not become long isolated one-person-per-row lists.
- Office, clerical, court, summons, warrant and special sections move away from Page 1 when density requires.
- Normal target: five or six sheets. Dense/event charts may use seven. Do not exceed the original without a clear readability reason.
- Six or seven readable sheets are preferable to fewer unreadable sheets.
- Every source row must remain represented. No truncation, silent merging or invented data.
- `रिक्त`, `बंद` and `बिमा` remain separate explicit concepts.
- Every editable presentation element may support:
  - left/center/right alignment;
  - top/middle/bottom alignment;
  - compact mode;
  - explicit hiding of empty or unnecessary rows.
- Empty RTPC/operator/support fields are never automatically hidden. The clerk explicitly controls visibility.
- Assignment editing must happen in a viewport-safe popup or inspector:
  - edit current master staff;
  - select existing staff;
  - create new staff and assign immediately;
  - clear to `रिक्त`;
  - edit time, BIMA and notes.
- Finalization is not a destructive toggle:
  - finalized chart remains immutable;
  - “reopen” creates a new amendment draft;
  - the prior finalized version remains available.
- React owns the screen and authoring experience; `ChartDocument` and the server renderer remain the print/PDF authority.

Relevant decision history: [mega.txt](mega.txt), especially the final user corrections; [PRODUCT_UI_ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/PRODUCT_UI_ARCHITECTURE.md) §§2–12; [SESSION_HANDOFF.md](docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md) §§3–5.

**2. Current Implementation**

- React demo route: `/app/charts/2026-09-10`
  - Owner: [src/app/main.tsx](src/app/main.tsx)
  - Styles: [src/app/styles.css](src/app/styles.css)
  - Renders the native compact chart surface and assignment editor.

  - Owner: [server/render/chart-html.ts](server/render/chart-html.ts)

  - [web/authoring.css](web/authoring.css)

Current implementation truth is recorded in [CURRENT_STATE.md](docs/CURRENT_STATE.md).

**3. Requested Behaviors**

- Persistent grouped navigation:
  - Dashboard;
  - Daily Duty Charts;
  - Operations;
  - Data.
- Disabled future leaves must visibly say `Coming Soon`, `WIP`, `Planned` or `Reference`.

**1. Final Design Decisions**

- The old six-page Panchavati chart is reference-only, not the active design target.
- The active target is a compact-v4 evolution of `design/panchavati-compv3.html`, preserving all source data while improving density.
- The chart must remain a calm operational document, not a dashboard:
  - no cards around every section;
  - no shadows, pills, decorative icons, double borders or excessive whitespace;
  - thin rules, disciplined tables, horizontal bands and lanes.
- Persistent application header:
  - Maharashtra Police logo;
  - station identity;
  - grouped navigation;
  - language toggle;
  - richer date selector.
- English and Marathi labels must not be duplicated. UI language controls labels; source names, ranks and protected operational terms remain unchanged.
- Chart-specific controls belong below the persistent header:
  - lifecycle state;
  - edit;
  - finalize;
  - print.
- Printed header is one centered line:

  `नाशिक शहर पोलीस आयुक्तालय      दैनिक कर्तव्य वाटप      १० सप्टेंबर २०२६, गुरुवार`

- Page 1 keeps the SPI-approved hierarchy:
  - senior officer in one compact line;
  - dynamic writer/driver/RTPC/operator columns;
  - four subordinate officer areas in a compact horizontal grid;
  - paired day/night deployment below.
- Day and night use comparable groupings. They must not become long isolated one-person-per-row lists.
- Office, clerical, court, summons, warrant and special sections move away from Page 1 when density requires.
- Normal target: five or six sheets. Dense/event charts may use seven. Do not exceed the original without a clear readability reason.
- Six or seven readable sheets are preferable to fewer unreadable sheets.
- Every source row must remain represented. No truncation, silent merging or invented data.
- `रिक्त`, `बंद` and `बिमा` remain separate explicit concepts.
- Every editable presentation element may support:
  - left/center/right alignment;
  - top/middle/bottom alignment;
  - compact mode;
  - explicit hiding of empty or unnecessary rows.
- Empty RTPC/operator/support fields are never automatically hidden. The clerk explicitly controls visibility.
- Assignment editing must happen in a viewport-safe popup or inspector:
  - edit current master staff;
  - select existing staff;
  - create new staff and assign immediately;
  - clear to `रिक्त`;
  - edit time, BIMA and notes.
- Finalization is not a destructive toggle:
  - finalized chart remains immutable;
  - “reopen” creates a new amendment draft;
  - the prior finalized version remains available.
- React owns the screen and authoring experience; `ChartDocument` and the server renderer remain the print/PDF authority.

Relevant decision history: [mega.txt](mega.txt), especially the final user corrections; [PRODUCT_UI_ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/PRODUCT_UI_ARCHITECTURE.md) §§2–12; [SESSION_HANDOFF.md](docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md) §§3–5.

  - 10/09 DRAFT chart;

# Compact-v4 Decisions

This file condenses the later user corrections in `mega.txt`. Later entries supersede earlier brainstorms.

## Active Surface

- The active demo is the verified server-rendered chart at `/charts/:date`.
- `/app/charts/:date` redirects to it. There must not be two chart implementations or an iframe preview.
- `server/chart-document.ts` remains the projection boundary and `server/render/chart-html.ts` remains print authority.
- The React files are a future screen refactor surface only until they can render the same ChartDocument without loss.
- `design/compv3.css` and `design/panchavati-compv3.html` are historical visual references, not authoritative 10/09 data.

## App Chrome

| Area | Required shape |
|---|---|
| Persistent header | Logo, Panchavati Police Station identity, grouped navigation, language toggle, date selector, clerk identity |
| Header exclusions | No DRAFT, FINALIZED, edit, finalize or print actions in the persistent identity/header area |
| Chart toolbar | Directly below header; chart title, date/weekday, lifecycle, संपादन, अंतिम करा or सुधारणा सुरू करा, प्रिंट |
| Language | Show one UI language at a time; never duplicate English and Marathi labels |
| Future navigation | Show real future areas as Coming Soon, WIP, Planned or Reference; never pretend incomplete routes work |

## Printed Identity

One compact centered line:

```text
नाशिक शहर पोलीस आयुक्तालय      दैनिक कर्तव्य वाटप      १० सप्टेंबर २०२६, गुरुवार
```

No `दिनांक`, `वार`, decorative dot, em dash, duplicated language, large title stack or empty header block.

## Page 1

1. Senior officer identity on one line: `वपोनि गजेंद्र पाटील ठाणे प्रमुख`.
2. Dynamic support columns: writer, driver, RTPC, operator only when source-backed.
3. Writer has no day/night split unless the source has one.
4. Driver, RTPC and operator may use compact day/night subdivisions.
5. Four subordinate officer blocks remain horizontally arranged, in two compact rows when needed.
6. Officer blocks begin directly with name and branch; no `अधिकारी १`, `अधिकारी २` heading row.
7. Lower content keeps comparable day/night groupings side by side.
8. Office, clerical, court, summons, warrant and special content moves away from Page 1 when density requires.
9. Empty/unsupported support groups can be individually hidden through explicit presentation controls, never auto-inferred.
10. Never invent writer, RTPC, operator or officer relationships.

## Content Grammar

- Use horizontal bands, disciplined columns, thin rules and light heading bands.
- Avoid dashboard cards, shadows, nested rounded cards, double borders, decorative pills and oversized empty padding.
- Do not render one large row/card per person.
- Group repeated role labels and let names wrap inside their own group.
- Day/night first-three logical groupings remain comparable.
- Chowki blocks show name, प्रभारी, BIMA people, remaining staff, रिक्त, and explicit बंद/चार्ज state.
- Marshal is a separate operational post and may fold visually into its paired chowki without losing state.
- BIMA is assignment-level and explicit; बंद is location-level; रिक्त is a vacant seat.
- Protected source terms and Marathi spellings remain unchanged.

## Sheets

| Sheet | Content |
|---|---|
| 1 | Senior officer, four subordinate officers, compact station day/night core |
| 2 | Office/clerical, court, summons, warrant and special duties |
| 3 | Six-chowki day/night matrix, BIMA, marshal, बंद and चार्ज |
| 4 | Night instructions and notices; may combine with Sheet 5 when sparse |
| 5 | Leave and other duties |
| 6 | Manpower, source values, summaries and sudden-change ledger |
| 7 | Officer summary, two compact scan tables and sign-off when density requires |

Target: 5–6 sheets normally, 6–7 for dense/event days; 10/09 must remain readable and no more than 6 where possible.

## CRUD

The assignment editor is one centered viewport-safe modal/flyout:

```text
कर्मचारी नेमणूक
  सध्याचा कर्मचारी
    कर्मचारी माहिती बदला
    रिक्त करा
  हजर कर्मचारी निवडा
    name / English name / buckle / rank search
  नवीन कर्मचारी जोडा
    Marathi name, English name, rank, buckle, phone
  या नेमणुकीसाठी
    time, explicit BIMA, notes
```

Master fields and assignment fields stay separate. Save through the existing narrow APIs, preserve the clicked slot, support Escape/outside click/internal scroll, show success/failure, and never auto-replace or schedule.

## Lifecycle

`DRAFT → VALIDATED → FINALIZED`. Finalized charts are immutable. `सुधारणा सुरू करा` creates a new amendment draft; it does not mutate the finalized chart.

## Rejected Approaches

- Legacy six-page chart as the active product.
- Kushal standardized long scrolling mega-table.
- Generic KPI/dashboard home.
- Embedded old chart inside a React iframe.
- Duplicate React/server chart implementations.
- Invented assignment relationships.
- Silent translation/transliteration.
- Arbitrary persisted HTML/CSS/JS layout.

  override → default; `a(key,def)` emits `data-label` (stable key) + `data-default` (SOURCE text,

# Compact-v4 Decisions

This file condenses the later user corrections in `mega.txt`. Later entries supersede earlier brainstorms.

## Active Surface

- The active demo is the verified server-rendered chart at `/charts/:date`.
- `/app/charts/:date` redirects to it. There must not be two chart implementations or an iframe preview.
- `server/chart-document.ts` remains the projection boundary and `server/render/chart-html.ts` remains print authority.
- The React files are a future screen refactor surface only until they can render the same ChartDocument without loss.
- `design/compv3.css` and `design/panchavati-compv3.html` are historical visual references, not authoritative 10/09 data.

## App Chrome

| Area | Required shape |
|---|---|
| Persistent header | Logo, Panchavati Police Station identity, grouped navigation, language toggle, date selector, clerk identity |
| Header exclusions | No DRAFT, FINALIZED, edit, finalize or print actions in the persistent identity/header area |
| Chart toolbar | Directly below header; chart title, date/weekday, lifecycle, संपादन, अंतिम करा or सुधारणा सुरू करा, प्रिंट |
| Language | Show one UI language at a time; never duplicate English and Marathi labels |
| Future navigation | Show real future areas as Coming Soon, WIP, Planned or Reference; never pretend incomplete routes work |

## Printed Identity

One compact centered line:

```text
नाशिक शहर पोलीस आयुक्तालय      दैनिक कर्तव्य वाटप      १० सप्टेंबर २०२६, गुरुवार
```

No `दिनांक`, `वार`, decorative dot, em dash, duplicated language, large title stack or empty header block.

## Page 1

1. Senior officer identity on one line: `वपोनि गजेंद्र पाटील ठाणे प्रमुख`.
2. Dynamic support columns: writer, driver, RTPC, operator only when source-backed.
3. Writer has no day/night split unless the source has one.
4. Driver, RTPC and operator may use compact day/night subdivisions.
5. Four subordinate officer blocks remain horizontally arranged, in two compact rows when needed.
6. Officer blocks begin directly with name and branch; no `अधिकारी १`, `अधिकारी २` heading row.
7. Lower content keeps comparable day/night groupings side by side.
8. Office, clerical, court, summons, warrant and special content moves away from Page 1 when density requires.
9. Empty/unsupported support groups can be individually hidden through explicit presentation controls, never auto-inferred.
10. Never invent writer, RTPC, operator or officer relationships.

## Content Grammar

- Use horizontal bands, disciplined columns, thin rules and light heading bands.
- Avoid dashboard cards, shadows, nested rounded cards, double borders, decorative pills and oversized empty padding.
- Do not render one large row/card per person.
- Group repeated role labels and let names wrap inside their own group.
- Day/night first-three logical groupings remain comparable.
- Chowki blocks show name, प्रभारी, BIMA people, remaining staff, रिक्त, and explicit बंद/चार्ज state.
- Marshal is a separate operational post and may fold visually into its paired chowki without losing state.
- BIMA is assignment-level and explicit; बंद is location-level; रिक्त is a vacant seat.
- Protected source terms and Marathi spellings remain unchanged.

## Sheets

| Sheet | Content |
|---|---|
| 1 | Senior officer, four subordinate officers, compact station day/night core |
| 2 | Office/clerical, court, summons, warrant and special duties |
| 3 | Six-chowki day/night matrix, BIMA, marshal, बंद and चार्ज |
| 4 | Night instructions and notices; may combine with Sheet 5 when sparse |
| 5 | Leave and other duties |
| 6 | Manpower, source values, summaries and sudden-change ledger |
| 7 | Officer summary, two compact scan tables and sign-off when density requires |

Target: 5–6 sheets normally, 6–7 for dense/event days; 10/09 must remain readable and no more than 6 where possible.

## CRUD

The assignment editor is one centered viewport-safe modal/flyout:

```text
कर्मचारी नेमणूक
  सध्याचा कर्मचारी
    कर्मचारी माहिती बदला
    रिक्त करा
  हजर कर्मचारी निवडा
    name / English name / buckle / rank search
  नवीन कर्मचारी जोडा
    Marathi name, English name, rank, buckle, phone
  या नेमणुकीसाठी
    time, explicit BIMA, notes
```

Master fields and assignment fields stay separate. Save through the existing narrow APIs, preserve the clicked slot, support Escape/outside click/internal scroll, show success/failure, and never auto-replace or schedule.

## Lifecycle

`DRAFT → VALIDATED → FINALIZED`. Finalized charts are immutable. `सुधारणा सुरू करा` creates a new amendment draft; it does not mutate the finalized chart.

## Rejected Approaches

- Legacy six-page chart as the active product.
- Kushal standardized long scrolling mega-table.
- Generic KPI/dashboard home.
- Embedded old chart inside a React iframe.
- Duplicate React/server chart implementations.
- Invented assignment relationships.
- Silent translation/transliteration.
- Arbitrary persisted HTML/CSS/JS layout.
"}

# Compact-v4 Decisions

This file condenses the later user corrections in `mega.txt`. Later entries supersede earlier brainstorms.

## Active Surface

- The active demo is the verified server-rendered chart at `/charts/:date`.
- `/app/charts/:date` redirects to it. There must not be two chart implementations or an iframe preview.
- `server/chart-document.ts` remains the projection boundary and `server/render/chart-html.ts` remains print authority.
- The React files are a future screen refactor surface only until they can render the same ChartDocument without loss.
- `design/compv3.css` and `design/panchavati-compv3.html` are historical visual references, not authoritative 10/09 data.

## App Chrome

| Area | Required shape |
|---|---|
| Persistent header | Logo, Panchavati Police Station identity, grouped navigation, language toggle, date selector, clerk identity |
| Header exclusions | No DRAFT, FINALIZED, edit, finalize or print actions in the persistent identity/header area |
| Chart toolbar | Directly below header; chart title, date/weekday, lifecycle, संपादन, अंतिम करा or सुधारणा सुरू करा, प्रिंट |
| Language | Show one UI language at a time; never duplicate English and Marathi labels |
| Future navigation | Show real future areas as Coming Soon, WIP, Planned or Reference; never pretend incomplete routes work |

## Printed Identity

One compact centered line:

```text
नाशिक शहर पोलीस आयुक्तालय      दैनिक कर्तव्य वाटप      १० सप्टेंबर २०२६, गुरुवार
```

No `दिनांक`, `वार`, decorative dot, em dash, duplicated language, large title stack or empty header block.

## Page 1

1. Senior officer identity on one line: `वपोनि गजेंद्र पाटील ठाणे प्रमुख`.
2. Dynamic support columns: writer, driver, RTPC, operator only when source-backed.
3. Writer has no day/night split unless the source has one.
4. Driver, RTPC and operator may use compact day/night subdivisions.
5. Four subordinate officer blocks remain horizontally arranged, in two compact rows when needed.
6. Officer blocks begin directly with name and branch; no `अधिकारी १`, `अधिकारी २` heading row.
7. Lower content keeps comparable day/night groupings side by side.
8. Office, clerical, court, summons, warrant and special content moves away from Page 1 when density requires.
9. Empty/unsupported support groups can be individually hidden through explicit presentation controls, never auto-inferred.
10. Never invent writer, RTPC, operator or officer relationships.

## Content Grammar

- Use horizontal bands, disciplined columns, thin rules and light heading bands.
- Avoid dashboard cards, shadows, nested rounded cards, double borders, decorative pills and oversized empty padding.
- Do not render one large row/card per person.
- Group repeated role labels and let names wrap inside their own group.
- Day/night first-three logical groupings remain comparable.
- Chowki blocks show name, प्रभारी, BIMA people, remaining staff, रिक्त, and explicit बंद/चार्ज state.
- Marshal is a separate operational post and may fold visually into its paired chowki without losing state.
- BIMA is assignment-level and explicit; बंद is location-level; रिक्त is a vacant seat.
- Protected source terms and Marathi spellings remain unchanged.

## Sheets

| Sheet | Content |
|---|---|
| 1 | Senior officer, four subordinate officers, compact station day/night core |
| 2 | Office/clerical, court, summons, warrant and special duties |
| 3 | Six-chowki day/night matrix, BIMA, marshal, बंद and चार्ज |
| 4 | Night instructions and notices; may combine with Sheet 5 when sparse |
| 5 | Leave and other duties |
| 6 | Manpower, source values, summaries and sudden-change ledger |
| 7 | Officer summary, two compact scan tables and sign-off when density requires |

Target: 5–6 sheets normally, 6–7 for dense/event days. The measured 10/09 implementation is 7 sheets because
moving office/court/special content off Page 1 cannot fit the chowki matrix without overflow; readability and no-loss
content take priority over forcing six.

## CRUD

The assignment editor is one centered viewport-safe modal/flyout:

```text
कर्मचारी नेमणूक
  सध्याचा कर्मचारी
    कर्मचारी माहिती बदला
    रिक्त करा
  हजर कर्मचारी निवडा
    name / English name / buckle / rank search
  नवीन कर्मचारी जोडा
    Marathi name, English name, rank, buckle, phone
  या नेमणुकीसाठी
    time, explicit BIMA, notes
```

Master fields and assignment fields stay separate. Save through the existing narrow APIs, preserve the clicked slot, support Escape/outside click/internal scroll, show success/failure, and never auto-replace or schedule.

## Lifecycle

`DRAFT → VALIDATED → FINALIZED`. Finalized charts are immutable. `सुधारणा सुरू करा` creates a new amendment draft; it does not mutate the finalized chart.

## Rejected Approaches

- Legacy six-page chart as the active product.
- Kushal standardized long scrolling mega-table.
- Generic KPI/dashboard home.
- Embedded old chart inside a React iframe.
- Duplicate React/server chart implementations.
- Invented assignment relationships.
- Silent translation/transliteration.
- Arbitrary persisted HTML/CSS/JS layout.

It will query the existing PostgreSQL fixture only, emit a UTF-8 Markdown/JSON report, and make the later layout plan reproducible without changing chart behavior.

edits.text:
import fs from "node:fs";
import pg from "pg";

const pool = new pg.Pool({ database: "panchavati3_dev", user: "postgres", host: "127.0.0.1" });
const query = (sql) => pool.query(sql).then((result) => result.rows);

const main = async () => {
  const byColumn = await query(`
    SELECT shift, column_no, count(*)::int AS rows,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE staff_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS staffed,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE staff_id IS NULL)::int AS vacant
      FROM daily_assignments a JOIN daily_charts c USING (chart_id)
     WHERE c.chart_date = '2026-09-10'
     GROUP BY shift, column_no ORDER BY shift, column_no`);
  const byLocation = await query(`
    SELECT shift, column_no, coalesce(l.name_mr, '(location-less)') AS location,
           count(*)::int AS rows,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE staff_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS staffed
      FROM daily_assignments a JOIN daily_charts c USING (chart_id)
      LEFT JOIN locations l USING (location_id)
     WHERE c.chart_date = '2026-09-10'
     GROUP BY shift, column_no, l.name_mr ORDER BY shift, column_no, location`);
  const groups = await query(`
    SELECT shift, column_no, coalesce(a.duty_title_mr, d.title_mr, '(untitled)') AS duty,
           count(*)::int AS rows,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE staff_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS staffed
      FROM daily_assignments a JOIN daily_charts c USING (chart_id)
      LEFT JOIN duty_definitions d USING (duty_id)
     WHERE c.chart_date = '2026-09-10'
     GROUP BY shift, column_no, duty ORDER BY shift, column_no, min(a.sort_order)`);
  const states = await query(`
    SELECT s.shift, l.name_mr, s.is_closed, coalesce(ch.name_mr, '') AS charge_to
      FROM location_operational_states s JOIN daily_charts c USING (chart_id)
      JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = s.location_id
      LEFT JOIN locations ch ON ch.location_id = s.charge_destination_location_id
     WHERE c.chart_date = '2026-09-10'
     ORDER BY s.shift, l.display_order`);
  const report = [
    "# 10/09 Density Audit",
    "",
    "> Generated from `panchavati3_dev` normalized chart data. This is a measurement artifact, not a source-authority claim.",
    "",
    "## Assignments By Shift/Column",
    "",
    "| Shift | Source column | Rows | Staffed | Vacant |",
    "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
    ...byColumn.map((r) => `| ${r.shift} | ${r.column_no} | ${r.rows} | ${r.staffed} | ${r.vacant} |`),
    "",
    "## Assignments By Shift/Column/Location",
    "",
    "| Shift | Column | Location | Rows | Staffed |",
    "|---|---:|---|---:|---:|",
    ...byLocation.map((r) => `| ${r.shift} | ${r.column_no} | ${r.location} | ${r.rows} | ${r.staffed} |`),
    "",
    "## Duty Groups",
    "",
    "| Shift | Column | Duty group | Rows | Staffed |",
    "|---|---:|---|---:|---:|",
    ...groups.map((r) => `| ${r.shift} | ${r.column_no} | ${r.duty} | ${r.rows} | ${r.staffed} |`),
    "",
    "## Location States",
    "",
    "| Shift | Location | Closed | Charge destination |",
    "|---|---|---|---|",
    ...states.map((r) => `| ${r.shift} | ${r.name_mr} | ${r.is_closed ? "बंद" : "कार्यरत"} | ${r.charge_to || ""} |`),
    "",
  ].join("\n");
  fs.writeFileSync(".tmp-density-1009.md", report, "utf8");
  console.log(report);
  await pool.end();
};

main().catch(async (error) => { console.error(error); await pool.end(); process.exit(1); });

The exact report gives us the key fact we were missing:

- Day source column 1: 35 rows.
- Night source column 1: 30 rows.
- Day column 2: 26 rows.
- Night column 2: 28 rows.
- Day column 3: 36 rows.

<!--
Purpose: Evidence-first density/layout audit for the real 2026-09-10 chart.
Current role: Planning artifact before the next chart-layout implementation pass.
Last meaningful change: 2026-10-13 — exact DB counts and live DOM geometry captured.
Constraint: No product layout was changed while producing this audit.
-->

# 10/09 Compact-v4 Density Audit

## Scope

This audit uses the current normalized `panchavati3_dev` 10/09 DRAFT fixture and the live `/charts/2026-09-10` DOM. It does not treat the frozen `design/` mock as complete 10/09 data.

Verified fixture facts:

- 212 assignments
- DAY: 125 rows across source columns 1–4
- NIGHT: 77 rows across source columns 1–3
- 10 explicit BIMA assignments
- 2 explicit रिक्त slots
- 7 location-state rows
- 69 availability rows
- 28 notices
- 240 manpower cells
- 15 officer-summary rows
- 12 scan rows

The seed remains a provisional implementation fixture because its mechanical authority is `reference/SEMANTIC/10.md`; originals-first reconciliation is still a separate evidence task.

## Root Cause Found

The live Page 1 lower wrapper is rendered as:

```html
<div class="g-core">
```

The stylesheet defines the two-column grid on `.grid.g-core`, but the wrapper does not carry the `grid` class. Browser measurement at a 1440px viewport:

| Element | Measured height |
|---|---:|
| Page 1 | 1,138.13px |
| Senior officer block | 100px |
| Officer grid | 56.60px |
| Day core block | 417.94px |
| Night core block | 456.91px |
| Current `.g-core` | 874.85px |

Computed style reports `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` but `display: block`; therefore the day and night blocks stack vertically. Adding the existing `grid` layout behavior would make the paired core height approximately `max(417.94, 456.91)`, saving about **417.94px** before any further density work.

This is a concrete bug, not a design guess.

## Other Measured Whitespace

The office/special sheet currently has two `.g-desk` blocks with equal measured heights:

| Block | Actual content is unequal, but measured height |
|---|---:|
| कार्यालयीन शाखा व कारकून | 756.61px |
| कोर्ट, समन्स, वॉरंट व विशेष कक्ष | 756.61px |

The equal height is CSS grid item stretching, not content demand. The office grid should use `align-items: start`; each register then grows only to its own content.

## Exact Assignment Density

### Source columns

| Shift | Column | Rows | Staffed | Vacant |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| DAY | 1 | 35 | 23 | 12 |
| DAY | 2 | 26 | 19 | 7 |
| DAY | 3 | 36 | 18 | 18 |
| DAY | 4 | 38 | 22 | 16 |
| NIGHT | 1 | 30 | 19 | 11 |
| NIGHT | 2 | 28 | 18 | 10 |
| NIGHT | 3 | 19 | 6 | 13 |

### Logical ownership

| Data family | Source rows | Proposed visual ownership |
|---|---:|---|
| Station/senior/officer core | DAY col 1 + NIGHT col 1 | Sheet 1, paired DAY/NIGHT lanes |
| Six chowkis | DAY col 2 + NIGHT col 2 | Sheet 2, 3×2 chowki matrix, each block DAY/NIGHT side by side |
| Marshal and fixed/special posts | DAY/NIGHT col 3 | Fold marshal state into paired chowki; fixed/special rows on Sheet 3 |
| Office and clerical | DAY col 4 | Sheet 3 office register |
| Court/summons/warrant | DAY col 4 court-coded rows | Sheet 3 court register |
| Availability | 69 rows | Sheet 4 flowing registers |
| Notices | 28 rows | Sheet 5 instruction register |
| Manpower/summaries | 240 cells + shift/ledger | Sheet 6 |
| Officer/scans/sign-off | 15 + 12 rows | Sheet 7 |

## Page 1 Row Plan

This is the row grammar to implement and measure, not a literal final pixel mock:

| Visual row/band | Contents | Density rule |
|---|---|---|
| Identity | `नाशिक शहर पोलीस आयुक्तालय` / `दैनिक कर्तव्य वाटप` / `१० सप्टेंबर २०२६, गुरुवार` | One line; no `दिनांक`, `वार`, dot, em dash or pill |
| Senior command | `वपोनि गजेंद्र पाटील ठाणे प्रमुख` | One horizontal line |
| Senior support | Writer, then source-backed driver/RTPC/operator columns | Dynamic columns; unsupported groups hidden only by explicit presentation override |
| Officer row 1 | Officer boxes 1 and 2 | Name + branch first; compact writer/RTPC/operator lines below |
| Officer row 2 | Officer boxes 3 and 4 | Same geometry; no `अधिकारी १/२` heading row |
| Paired core | DAY and NIGHT column-1 duty groups side by side | Shared group families align vertically where possible; each cell may contain multiple people |

The paired core should not repeat every person as a large card. Its left role column is compact; the value column wraps Marathi names within the group.

### Column-1 group families to align

| Comparable family | DAY data | NIGHT data |
|---|---|---|
| Station amaldar | ठाणे अंमलदार / room watch | ठाणे अंमलदार |
| Attendance | हजरपाळी | हजरपाळी |
| CCTNS | CCTNS | CCTNS |
| Wireless | वायरलेस | वायरलेस |
| Peter mobile | पिटर मोबाईल | पिटर मोबाईल |
| CR mobile | सी.आर. मोबाईल | सी.आर. मोबाईल |
| DB/crime search | गुन्हे शोध पथक/DB | गुन्हे शोध पथक/DB |
| Lockup | पो.स्टे. लॉकअप गार्ड | पो.स्टे. लॉकअप गार्ड |
| Day-only | Delta mobile, station-specific rows |  |
| Night-only |  | checking, night patrol officer |

This alignment uses the actual group families and does not fabricate personnel relationships.

## Sheet 2 Chowki Matrix

Use six blocks in a 3×2 matrix at wide desktop widths, 2×3 at narrower desktop, and retain DAY/NIGHT as internal columns until the mobile projection breakpoint.

Each block:

```text
चौकी नाव
अधि. <प्रभारी>  <plain source-backed time only when present>
दिवसपाळी                         रात्रपाळी
role | staff                     role | staff
BIMA rows inline                 BIMA rows inline
मार्शल: बंद / चार्ज ...          only when explicit
```

Rules:

- No blue timing chip.
- No `·` separator.
- No `वेळ:` label on every chowki.
- No `०९–१४` chip beside every heading.
- If a source-backed in-charge window is shown, use plain text after the person, e.g. `अधि. ... ०९ ते १४`.
- `बंद`, `चार्ज`, `मार्शल` and `बिमा` remain explicit text/state semantics, not color-only signals.
- Marshal rows may fold into the chowki visually, but their separate operational state must remain represented.

## Sheet 3 Office/Special

Two independent flowing registers, aligned to the top:

| Left register | Right register |
|---|---|
| कार्यालयीन शाखा व कारकून | कोर्ट, समन्स, वॉरंट व विशेष कक्ष |
| role once, people below | duty once, people below |
| no equal-height blank fill | no card-per-person treatment |

The measured current equal-height behavior is false whitespace and should be removed with top alignment.

## Timing Rule

The chart should show shift identity once:

```text
दिवसपाळी ०९:०० ते २१:००        रात्रपाळी २१:०० ते ०९:००
```

Do not repeat timing as a colored chip on every chowki. Do not render decorative `·` separators. Typed assignment windows remain available in the editor/detail context and appear in the chart only where source data explicitly supplies a meaningful split window.

## Whitespace Budget

Measured facts support these immediate geometry changes:

1. Fix the missing `grid` class on the Page 1 paired core: estimated screen saving ≈ 418px at the measured 1440px viewport.
2. Set `.g-desk` to `align-items: start`: removes artificial equal-height office/court blank space.
3. Keep the four officer blocks exempt from aggressive collapse because their horizontal presence is SPI-approved.
4. Keep the chowki matrix dense and side-by-side; do not make DAY and NIGHT sequential inside each block.
5. Hide repeated screen page headers after the first page while retaining repeated headers for print, if screen inspection confirms the repeated identity is distracting.
6. Measure again at desktop widths 1440, 1200, 1024 and 768 before changing typography.

## Acceptance Checks Before Implementation

- DOM computed style confirms Page 1 core is `display:grid` with two columns.
- Day and night core blocks share one vertical band on desktop.
- Page 1 height is reduced by the measured stacking amount without row loss.
- Six chowki blocks remain present and each retains DAY/NIGHT internal structure.
- `बिमा`, `बंद`, marshal and charge lines remain explicit.
- No `·` timing separators or colored per-chowki timing chips remain.
- Office/court registers top-align and do not stretch to the same height.
- Full no-loss count remains 212/212.
- `npm run check` and `npm run print:audit` pass after implementation.

# 10/09 Compact-v4 Density Audit

## Scope

This audit uses the current normalized `panchavati3_dev` 10/09 DRAFT fixture and the live `/charts/2026-09-10` DOM. It does not treat the frozen `design/` mock as complete 10/09 data.

Verified fixture facts:

- 212 assignments
- DAY: 125 rows across source columns 1–4
- NIGHT: 77 rows across source columns 1–3
- 10 explicit BIMA assignments
- 2 explicit रिक्त slots
- 7 location-state rows
- 69 availability rows
- 28 notices
- 240 manpower cells
- 15 officer-summary rows
- 12 scan rows

The seed remains a provisional implementation fixture because its mechanical authority is `reference/SEMANTIC/10.md`; originals-first reconciliation is still a separate evidence task.

## Root Cause Found

The live Page 1 lower wrapper is rendered as:

```html
<div class="g-core">
```

The stylesheet defines the two-column grid on `.grid.g-core`, but the wrapper does not carry the `grid` class. Browser measurement at a 1440px viewport:

| Element | Measured height |
|---|---:|
| Page 1 | 1,138.13px |
| Senior officer block | 100px |
| Officer grid | 56.60px |
| Day core block | 417.94px |
| Night core block | 456.91px |
| Current `.g-core` | 874.85px |

Computed style reports `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` but `display: block`; therefore the day and night blocks stack vertically. Adding the existing `grid` layout behavior would make the paired core height approximately `max(417.94, 456.91)`, saving about **417.94px** before any further density work.

This is a concrete bug, not a design guess.

## Other Measured Whitespace

The office/special sheet currently has two `.g-desk` blocks with equal measured heights:

| Block | Actual content is unequal, but measured height |
|---|---:|
| कार्यालयीन शाखा व कारकून | 756.61px |
| कोर्ट, समन्स, वॉरंट व विशेष कक्ष | 756.61px |

The equal height is CSS grid item stretching, not content demand. The office grid should use `align-items: start`; each register then grows only to its own content.

## Exact Assignment Density

### Source columns

| Shift | Column | Rows | Staffed | Vacant |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| DAY | 1 | 35 | 23 | 12 |
| DAY | 2 | 26 | 19 | 7 |
| DAY | 3 | 36 | 18 | 18 |
| DAY | 4 | 38 | 22 | 16 |
| NIGHT | 1 | 30 | 19 | 11 |
| NIGHT | 2 | 28 | 18 | 10 |
| NIGHT | 3 | 19 | 6 | 13 |

### Logical ownership

| Data family | Source rows | Proposed visual ownership |
|---|---:|---|
| Station/senior/officer core | DAY col 1 + NIGHT col 1 | Sheet 1, paired DAY/NIGHT lanes |
| Six chowkis | DAY col 2 + NIGHT col 2 | Sheet 2, 3×2 chowki matrix, each block DAY/NIGHT side by side |
| Marshal and fixed/special posts | DAY/NIGHT col 3 | Fold marshal state into paired chowki; fixed/special rows on Sheet 3 |
| Office and clerical | DAY col 4 | Sheet 3 office register |
| Court/summons/warrant | DAY col 4 court-coded rows | Sheet 3 court register |
| Availability | 69 rows | Sheet 4 flowing registers |
| Notices | 28 rows | Sheet 5 instruction register |
| Manpower/summaries | 240 cells + shift/ledger | Sheet 6 |
| Officer/scans/sign-off | 15 + 12 rows | Sheet 7 |

## Page 1 Row Plan

This is the row grammar to implement and measure, not a literal final pixel mock:

| Visual row/band | Contents | Density rule |
|---|---|---|
| Identity | `नाशिक शहर पोलीस आयुक्तालय` / `दैनिक कर्तव्य वाटप` / `१० सप्टेंबर २०२६, गुरुवार` | One line; no `दिनांक`, `वार`, dot, em dash or pill |
| Senior command | `वपोनि गजेंद्र पाटील ठाणे प्रमुख` | One horizontal line |
| Senior support | Writer, then source-backed driver/RTPC/operator columns | Dynamic columns; unsupported groups hidden only by explicit presentation override |
| Officer row 1 | Officer boxes 1 and 2 | Name + branch first; compact writer/RTPC/operator lines below |
| Officer row 2 | Officer boxes 3 and 4 | Same geometry; no `अधिकारी १/२` heading row |
| Paired core | DAY and NIGHT column-1 duty groups side by side | Shared group families align vertically where possible; each cell may contain multiple people |

The paired core should not repeat every person as a large card. Its left role column is compact; the value column wraps Marathi names within the group.

### Column-1 group families to align

| Comparable family | DAY data | NIGHT data |
|---|---|---|
| Station amaldar | ठाणे अंमलदार / room watch | ठाणे अंमलदार |
| Attendance | हजरपाळी | हजरपाळी |
| CCTNS | CCTNS | CCTNS |
| Wireless | वायरलेस | वायरलेस |

| Day-only | Delta mobile, station-specific rows |  |
| Night-only |  | checking, night patrol officer |

This alignment uses the actual group families and does not fabricate personnel relationships.

## Sheet 2 Chowki Matrix

Use six blocks in a 3×2 matrix at wide desktop widths, 2×3 at narrower desktop, and retain DAY/NIGHT as internal columns until the mobile projection breakpoint.

Each block:

```text
चौकी नाव
अधि. <प्रभारी>  <plain source-backed time only when present>
दिवसपाळी                         रात्रपाळी
role | staff                     role | staff
BIMA rows inline                 BIMA rows inline
मार्शल: बंद / चार्ज ...          only when explicit
```

Rules:

- No blue timing chip.
- No `·` separator.
- No `वेळ:` label on every chowki.
- No `०९–१४` chip beside every heading.
- If a source-backed in-charge window is shown, use plain text after the person, e.g. `अधि. ... ०९ ते १४`.
- `बंद`, `चार्ज`, `मार्शल` and `बिमा` remain explicit text/state semantics, not color-only signals.
- Marshal rows may fold into the chowki visually, but their separate operational state must remain represented.

## Sheet 3 Office/Special

Two independent flowing registers, aligned to the top:

| Left register | Right register |
|---|---|
| कार्यालयीन शाखा व कारकून | कोर्ट, समन्स, वॉरंट व विशेष कक्ष |
| role once, people below | duty once, people below |
| no equal-height blank fill | no card-per-person treatment |

The measured current equal-height behavior is false whitespace and should be removed with top alignment.

## Timing Rule

The chart should show shift identity once:

```text
दिवसपाळी ०९:०० ते २१:००        रात्रपाळी २१:०० ते ०९:००
```

Do not repeat timing as a colored chip on every chowki. Do not render decorative `·` separators. Typed assignment windows remain available in the editor/detail context and appear in the chart only where source data explicitly supplies a meaningful split window.

## Whitespace Budget

Measured facts support these immediate geometry changes:

1. Fix the missing `grid` class on the Page 1 paired core: estimated screen saving ≈ 418px at the measured 1440px viewport.
2. Set `.g-desk` to `align-items: start`: removes artificial equal-height office/court blank space.
3. Keep the four officer blocks exempt from aggressive collapse because their horizontal presence is SPI-approved.
4. Keep the chowki matrix dense and side-by-side; do not make DAY and NIGHT sequential inside each block.
5. Hide repeated screen page headers after the first page while retaining repeated headers for print, if screen inspection confirms the repeated identity is distracting.
6. Measure again at desktop widths 1440, 1200, 1024 and 768 before changing typography.

## Acceptance Checks Before Implementation

- DOM computed style confirms Page 1 core is `display:grid` with two columns.
- Day and night core blocks share one vertical band on desktop.
- Page 1 height is reduced by the measured stacking amount without row loss.
- Six chowki blocks remain present and each retains DAY/NIGHT internal structure.
- `बिमा`, `बंद`, marshal and charge lines remain explicit.
- No `·` timing separators or colored per-chowki timing chips remain.
- Office/court registers top-align and do not stretch to the same height.
- Full no-loss count remains 212/212.
- `npm run check` and `npm run print:audit` pass after implementation.
"}

- Do not render one large row/card per person.
- Group repeated role labels and let names wrap inside their own group.
- Day/night first-three logical groupings remain comparable.
- Chowki blocks show name, प्रभारी, BIMA people, remaining staff, रिक्त, and explicit बंद/चार्ज state.
- Marshal is a separate operational post and may fold visually into its paired chowki without losing state.
- BIMA is assignment-level and explicit; बंद is location-level; रिक्त is a vacant seat.
- Protected source terms and Marathi spellings remain unchanged.
| 1 | Senior officer, four subordinate officers, compact station day/night core |
| 2 | Office/clerical, court, summons, warrant and special duties |
| 3 | Six-chowki day/night matrix, BIMA, marshal, बंद and चार्ज |
| 4 | Night instructions and notices; may combine with Sheet 5 when sparse |
| 6 | Manpower, source values, summaries and sudden-change ledger |
| 7 | Officer summary, two compact scan tables and sign-off when density requires |
Target: 5–6 sheets normally, 6–7 for dense/event days. The measured 10/09 implementation is 7 sheets because
moving office/court/special content off Page 1 cannot fit the chowki matrix without overflow; readability and no-loss
content take priority over forcing six.
The assignment editor is one centered viewport-safe modal/flyout:
name / English name / buckle / rank search
Marathi name, English name, rank, buckle, phone

Master fields and assignment fields stay separate. Save through the existing narrow APIs, preserve the clicked slot, support Escape/outside click/internal scroll, show success/failure, and never auto-replace or schedule.
`DRAFT → VALIDATED → FINALIZED`. Finalized charts are immutable. `सुधारणा सुरू करा` creates a new amendment draft; it does not mutate the finalized chart.
- Legacy six-page chart as the active product.
- Embedded old chart inside a React iframe.
Purpose: Domain entities and operational rules distilled from the 10/09 + 11/09 charts and old-repo decisions.
Current role: Meaning authority — code implements this, never the reverse.
Last meaningful change: Created 2026-10-06 from audit evidence.
Constraint/dependency: Every concept traceable in TRACEABILITY.md; unknowns governed by OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.
Station: पंचवटी पोलीस ठाणे, नाशिक शहर. Charts are per-date documents containing two shifts.
| रिक्त | an existing duty slot with no person | state of a slot |
| बंद | location/chowki operationally closed that shift | state of a location; carries चार्ज → destination note |
| बिमा | per-person beat-marshal qualifier on an assignment | boolean field on assignment; `[बिमा]` chip |
| प्रभारी | the in-charge person of a chowki block | display role of an assignment |
| चार्ज (transfer) | consequence text of बंद ("चौकी चा चार्ज X कडे") | structured location-state field, not free note |
Never: विमा, पोषि. Never translate: CCTNS, Dial 112 MERS, DB, MERS, rank codes, TOTAL, Office, ME.
## Three distinct facts (verified 2026-10-08 against source Table 1)
1. **BIMA** = person-level qualifier on an *assignment* (that constable's posting IS the beat). Exists only where a person row exists.

2. **Marshal post** = a *separate operational post* with its own staffing — the source chart carries a dedicated marshal column (काटया मारूती मार्शल, पंचवटी कारंजा मार्शल, मालेगांव स्टँड मार्शल, फुले नगर मार्शल, मेरी मार्शल). It can be बंद with charge transferred while the neighbouring chowki is fully staffed.
3. **Chowki closure** = the *chowki* itself closed, charge to another chowki.

Source evidence (कारंजा day shift, Table 1): chowki column shows `सपोनि प्रशांत बोरसे 16 ते 21` + `चौकी चा चार्ज काटया मारूती चौकी कडे` while the marshal column independently shows `पंचवटी कारंजा मार्शल → बंद → चार्ज मालेगाव स्टँड कडे`. The DB therefore carries three explicit fields — `assignment.is_bima`, marshal-post `location_operational_state`, chowki `location_operational_state` — never inferred by parsing notes.
- **Rank** — 16 canonical codes; officers render rank+name, constables rank+buckle+name.
- **StaffMember** — full name, rank, buckle/service no, phone, active. Deactivation over deletion.

- **Location** — six chowkis (काटया मारूती, पंचवटी कारंजा, मालेगांव स्टॅड, सरदार, फुलेनगर, मेरी) + station + office + fixed points (काळाराम मंदिर, रामकुंड, मार्केट यार्ड…). Chowki order for scan config is stable configuration, not schema.
- **DutyDefinition** — recurring duties (HQ block, office catalog, marshal groups, मोबाईल पथक, गुडमाॅर्निंग स्काॅड…). ~49 seeded from source; clerk-editable.

- **DailyChart** — one per date; DAY 09:00–21:00 and NIGHT 21:00–09:00 (overnight, belongs to start date) are station-configured shift presets; assignments may carry typed split windows (09–14 + 16–21).

- **Assignment** — person? + duty + location? + shift + typed start/end + allocation state + status + source + BIMA + notes + unit?. One person may appear in multiple rows (source does this); one row may hold multiple people when the source does (support via multiple assignment rows sharing a slot grouping — SME N12).

- **Availability** — separate from assignment. Categories observed: साप्ताहिक सुट्टी, किरकोळ रजा (hourly), अर्जित रजा (date range), सिक, गैरहजर, प्रसुती रजा, बाल संगोपन रजा, हायकोर्ट-मुंबई, तपासकामी (city/state), प्रशिक्षण, प्रतिनियुक्ती, निर्भया/दामिनी पथक, मिसिंग सेल, कोर्ट पैरवी (सेशन/JMFC), वाघ जाप्ता, पो.स्टे.रिझर्व्ह, बाहेर बंदोबस्त. Availability conflicts produce warnings only.
- **SuddenDutyChange** — append-only ledger (कारण मीमांसा): original person, replacement?, reason, time, actor/version context.

- **ChartNotice** — ordered instructions: night directives (गुडमाॅर्निंग स्काॅड composition + रामकुंड पेट्रोलिंग + पुतळा भेटी + चौकी अंमलदार गस्त + बिट मार्शल 2-तास रिपोर्ट/सुरक्षित ॲप स्कॅन + आस्थापना बंद), day notices, event notices.

- **ScanSchedule** — stable config: morning 09–15 (chowki→in-charge), afternoon 15–21 (chowki→mobile: मेरी+फुलेनगर→सी.आर., काटया+कारंजा→डेल्टा, स्टॅड+सरदार→DB), 12 hourly windows 09–21 (rotating chowki, daily person), night 21–09 (chowki→mobile) + ग्रीन ॲप note. Daily rows: hourly staff, overrides.

- **ManpowerRecord** — rank × status matrix (मंजुर संख्याबळ, हजर मनुष्यबळ, Office=09, ME=233, प्रत्यक्ष हजर=03, deductions). Stored authoritative values + clearly-labeled derived values; never auto-reconciled.
- **OfficerSummary** — 15 subordinate officers (roster #2–#16; senior PI excluded) × कर्तव्य; derived suggestion with manual override; provenance recorded.
- **SpecialEvent** — e.g. गणेशोत्सव रंगीत तालीम, 11/09/2026, 10:00 fall-in at पो.स्टे.मैदान. Not hardcoded to Ganesh; type is data.
- **EventAssignment** — event + person + optional role (11/09: 11 personnel, rows 1–11 of Table 3).

- **EventEquipment** — event + person + lines: अतिरिक्त साहित्य (search light+दोर, मेगाफोन, व्हिडीओ कॅमेरा, गॅस गन+सेल with counts, षाॅटनग 12 बोअर+राउंड, एस.एल.आर+राउंड types, षिल्ड व लाठी) and अनिवार्य साहित्य (षिल्ड, लाठी, हेल्मेट, षिनगार्ड, बाॅडी प्रोटेक्टर).
- **EventInstruction** — fall-in order text + absentee warning (गैरहजर नोंद + कसुरी अहवाल).
- **Event annex** — print projection only; the packet's extra physical page is a renderer fact (11/09 evidence), never a schema fact.

DRAFT → VALIDATED → FINALIZED (no AMENDED state). Finalize freezes a complete snapshot; reprint replays snapshot. Correction = new version, fresh draft. Copy-previous: structural baseline + reusable roles copied; availability re-overlaid for the new date; conflicts flagged; source untouched.

The clerk picks every person. Software may: compute totals where proven, flag conflicts, warn on double-booking/leave overlap, suggest (never apply) page-5-style drafting. It must never: auto-select, auto-replace, auto-reconcile contradictory source numbers, or invent duties/procedure.
Typed columns only (HH:MM + dates). Displayed Devanagari digits (०९ ते १४) are presentation of typed values. Machine meaning never comes from note text.

Every block in the 10/09 and 11/09 source packets (see INITIAL_AUDIT §7 coverage tables) must be representable. Anything not on the compact board lives in a secondary panel — data-first, not page-first.
